calibration.outcome_use: Each held source sequence is scored once using moments fitted from the other source sequences. This is source development, not independent confirmation.

claim_boundary: Development-only cross-validated source evaluation on already-open public DOT R11-R20 using the immutable marker-free routed CUT3R artifact. Error moments are estimated from source marker outcomes and are not native CUT3R covariance. The study may establish algebraic query-message parity and descriptive real-source behavior under changing ranks. It cannot establish held-out performance, learned provider calibration or competence, BayesianPhysTwin or Causal4D benefit, robot safety, deployment validity, or state of the art. R21-R70 remain closed.

decision.harm_event: execute_query_update and realized squared error exceeds fallback squared error
decision.probability_definition: Under the method Gaussian, posterior probability that squared query error of the update is below squared error of zero-displacement fallback.

evaluation.query_definition: material-marker displacement from frame 3 to frame 4 normalized by frame-3 rope span

fusion.duplicate_control: repeat the byte-identical window-A message at weights 0.5/0.5

promotion.on_source_mixed_or_negative: Retain the source result and leave R21-R70 unopened.
promotion.on_source_positive: A separately versioned R21-R30 protocol must be frozen and reviewed before any confirmation access.

scientific_question: Do prior-anchored query messages and covariance-intersection fusion preserve useful real CUT3R displacement information while avoiding the overconfidence caused by treating overlapping windows as independent?

sealed_provider.covariance_interpretation: The provider supplies marker-free point maps and confidence only. Gaussian error moments are estimated leave-one-sequence-out from already-open source marker outcomes and are not claimed to be native CUT3R uncertainty.

source_decision_criteria.mixed_decision: Algebraic checks pass but one or more empirical utility criteria fail.
source_decision_criteria.positive_decision: All algebraic checks pass; CI is no worse than naive fusion in NLL, coverage distance, and harmful execution; and CI retains near-best single-window utility.

terminal_rank_diagnostic.interpretation: The fixed rank-six prerequisite remains terminal negative. This rank-agnostic study neither relaxes nor rescues that result.
